svg.text: 1. Viewer Request: Triggered when CloudFront receives a request from a viewer (before cache lookup)
2. Origin Request: Triggered when CloudFront forwards a request to origin (on cache miss only)
3. Origin Response: Triggered when CloudFront receives a response from origin (before caching)
4. Viewer Response: Triggered before CloudFront returns response to viewer (cache hit or miss)
Use Cases: Request routing, A/B testing, security headers, content modification, authentication, real-time image resizing
Use Cases: Request routing, A/B testing, security headers, content modification, authentication, real-time image resizing
